name: OpenDIMS Integration
brief: Exposes BC data OpenDIMS needs that the standard API does not cover.
description: Publishes read-only API endpoints for OpenDIMS: salesShipments and salesInvoiceLinks (shipment tracking), customerDiscountGroups, itemDiscountGroups and priceListLines (discount matrix sync), bomComponents (assembly BOM / composed products), odsItems and tableFields (every item field the standard API leaves out, including fields other extensions added to the item card), itemBomCosts (assembly BOM cost roll-up) itemStatistics (item ledger figures), odsCustomers and the sales documents open and posted, and the whole buying side — odsVendors, odsPurchaseDocuments and the posted purchase invoices and receipts, none of which Business Central's own API publishes at all — the ledgers (item, value, customer, vendor and G/L entries), and tableRecords — any table on the tenant by number, so data with no endpoint of its own is still reachable. Ships granular permission sets (OPENDIMS TRACKING / DISCOUNTS / BOM / ITEMS / CUSTOMERS / SALES / VENDORS / PURCHASES / LEDGERS / TABLE DATA) so each integration is granted only the data it uses.
